title: PNP logs 304 domestic violence complaints vs. cops in 2026
summary: The Philippine National Police (PNP) has recorded 304 complaints involving police officers accused of domestic violence from January 1 to November 9, 2026.

blocks.text: The Philippine National Police (PNP) has recorded 304 complaints involving police officers accused of domestic violence from January 1 to November 9, 2026.
At a press briefing, PNP spokesperson Police Brigadier General Allen Rae Co said that all the complaints had already been acted upon and included in its official records.
The PNP also recorded 338 similar complaints in 2025.
Co said investigations and proceedings involving the complaints are ongoing and that the PNP does not yet have a consolidated figure on their outcomes.
Meanwhile, the PNP urged victims of domestic violence to come forward and file complaints, assuring them that authorities would act on their reports.

“Ang babae hindi sinasaktan. This goes for everybody, for everyone. But don't resort to our resources. Kasi kayo na nga mismo supposed to be na nagpo-protect sa ating mga kababayan, especially iyong mga kababaihan. And ikaw pa ang magkakawa ng ganito. So, doble ang tama po sa atin,” he said.

(Women should not be harmed. This goes for everybody, for everyone. But don't resort to our resources. Because you are supposed to be protecting our countrymen, especially your women. And you are the one who will do this. So, its impact on us is double.)
“We do not condone it. We do not tolerate this kind of aggression. So if there is, stop it while there is still time. to change,” he added. —Joviland Rita/LDF, GMA News
